description: On a desktop-sized screen the new-conversation composer keeps the model and directory fields in a row, with only the directory labelled. The screen is 1280x800. Navigate to /new. 2. The model field and the directory field should be visible. 3. The labels' texts should be exactly ["Model:", "Dir:"]; the first label should be hidden and the last visible. 4.
